column3: Kuroneko Route · The Perspective of the Little Sister
What's up, something wrong?
...It's nothing, nothing at all.
But you were just staring over here just now.
Ah, no... you were looking over here because I was talking about Kuroneko. That's natural.
You must be worried about her.
W-Who would be worried about her?
I won't feel bored even if she isn't around.
In other words, she means "I can't help but get worried about her".
Poor Kirino, she looks like she can't bear it any more, even if she won't say it.
A close friend not being here, all of a sudden.
Well, it's not like she can say anything about other people.
That's exactly why she didn't make a big fuss, but is staying quiet about it.
The pain of having a "normal daily life" destroyed, I know that feeling very well.
It's not just Kirino. Even I find it quite painful being unable to see Kuroneko like usual.
As for what Kuroneko said, "Our world" is about to crumble.
But if I were not to step into Kuroneko's world, then it will also destroy our daily lives -- Our world.
Stepping into Kuroneko's world, I guess it means trying my best to turn things back to what it was. I'm sure that's it.
...Well, I don't know if it is possible to turn it back to before even if I do step in.
--Do I have that kind of right?
She's kind of reluctant, so can I even set foot into her issues?
.....You're an idiot.
Huh?
...It's nothing.
But besides that, go and do something already.
I know that.
If you understand, then get moving as always....
What's with Kirino...?
However, unless I step into her world, my world would surely change if this goes on...
Geez... How long are you going to be nervous for?
...Hehe.
W-What? Suddenly laughing like that...
You and Kuroneko sure have some similarities.
Huh?
If Kuroneko is my little sister...
You eccentric elder sister! Hurry up and outgrow your chuunibyou!
Even if we're family, it's embarrassing just to look at you, don't you understand?
...How noisy.
It's about time you become more mature, and more tolerant to the interests of others, right?
Just looking at you rambling on there, I feel so disgusted that it makes me feel nauseous.
Still, don't I keep it to myself? You should learn from me.
But didn't you say it out in the end!?
Seems like it's not too different from what's happening now...
Why are you laughing to yourself?
Well, should I say both of you are similar in character, or should I say you're both not being honest...
I was thinking that maybe you two really are sisters after all.
Can you not say such stupid things?
How could that deluded wannabe novelist be compared to a normal like me?
Yup, a reaction according to my expectations.
Stupid, that's not important. What's important is a person's true nature. What they are!
W-Who's the one calling us sisters?! A deluded chuuni like her... as my little sister...!
Hm... I guess it might work actually...
Did you just mix 2D and 3D together?!
Eh?
As long as it's sister-related, anything goes for you... furthermore, Kuroneko should be your elder sister since she's older than you.
W-Well... I guess.
Look how elated you are, don't you just want to have a little sister?
Tch... you're noisy.
If you have the time to be making stupid jokes, you should be dealing with her right now.
...I know.
She's like an 【untamed cat】, someone needs to stop her by force. Isn't that your specialty?
Yeah...
That's how I came at you before.
Though I still wonder if that was the correct choice.
If you get it, then get going and try it?
Because she's definitely waiting.
...Thanks.
I muttered thanks, with two meanings.
